task_description: Python backend-only forecasting for FairWatt MA: (A) a deterministic Monte Carlo 6-month consumption forecast (P10/P50/P90 fan + full quantiles) spanning the Feb 1 2027 reset, committed to data/build/forecast_mc.json; and (B) an all-cities (351 MA towns) 6-month-ahead forecast committed to data/build/allcities_forecast.json. No UI/TypeScript. All Python under forecast_mc_* / allcities_* prefixes.
